author: Jackuline Fly
title: Whole
rootCause: The governed 05-to-06 transition updated the lifecycle and emitted its transition evidence, but the transition plugin did not update the publishing-engagement stage projection in the same transaction.

repairAttempt.governanceInterpretation: A direct engagement-stage write is not authorized. Repair must execute through governed transition authority or an explicitly approved parity-repair path.

proposedPhase6Guard: The governed stage transition must update lifecycle stage and engagement-stage projection in one transaction, then assert physical workspace, lifecycle, and engagement parity before reporting success.
